name: events-check-since
description: Retro-check for matching events after a cursor: pass sinceEventId and the same contains/marker (sinceTimestampUtc optional). Returns all matches, not just the first. Use to recover after a wait timed out.

sinceEventId.description: Only events after this id (events-wait, a tool reply, or bridge-get-status lastEventId).

sinceTimestampUtc.description: Optional: also drop events older than this UTC time.

contains.description: Event MESSAGE substring (case-insensitive); a list matches any.

marker.description: Exact beacon name: a log line MCPEventReachedLocation(<name>) plants one.

maxEntries.description: Max number of matching events to return.

source.description: Advanced: restrict to one event origin. Defaults to any source.

type.description: Advanced: restrict to one internal event type.

level.description: Advanced: restrict by severity (e.g. Error, Warning, Log).

includeData.description: Include each event's structured data payload in the result.
